content:
# COMSTAR LDAP MCP — AO catalog (hosted on Ada / AI server).
# Session open must not depend on this MCP (ADR 0005).
#
# On Ada:
#   1. Run directory_sidecar (:8780) + ldap_mcp (:8794)
#   2. Set COMSTAR_LDAP_MCP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8794/mcp in AO env
#   3. Place this file under AO config/mcp_providers/ (or EXTRA path) and restart
id: ldap_directory
description: FreeIPA COMSTAR person lookup via directory sidecar
capabilities: >
  lookup_user by uid; list_comstar_users for enrolled comstarPerson entries.
  Biometric face/voice resolve stays on the Pi bridge sidecar path.
good_for: directory, ldap, freeipa, who is, user lookup, household roster
planner_hint: Use for person directory questions; never for session identity.
user_goal_keywords:
  - directory
  - ldap
  - freeipa
  - userid
  - who is enrolled
  - household

guest_allowed: false
required_env:
  - COMSTAR_LDAP_MCP_URL
streamable_http:
  url: "${COMSTAR_LDAP_MCP_URL}"
